title: TLS: Enable handshake reassembly across connection migration
description:
QUIC can have connection migration, and can have TLS fragments
that span connection migration.

We already create and store the handshake reassembly ids according
to the session and direction; create custom TLS handshake reassembly
functions that use the section and direction, and use them when
making fragment function calls.

This correctly retrieves fragments across connection migration and fixes
some warnings like:

    Dissector bug, protocol TLS, in packet 1038: epan/dissectors/packet-tls.c:2598: failed assertion "fh"

by reassembling the fragents in frame 324 and 1038 in the
rebind-port trace_node_right file in #16915.

Constify the packet_info parameter to ssl_packet_from_server, as
the reassembly function template requires a const packet_info.
